answer: An identity earns its seat through light client proof of Mantle state, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. A farm running 704 aliases would need 704 separate proofs, each costing about 116 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The comet of the design is public, the bridge of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the knoll of honest work is what finally pays. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
